title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text: ‘which was neither free nor fair, was held in violation of democratic norms and standards, and did not reflect the will of the people of Georgia; underlines that the extensive electoral fraud has undermined the integrity of the election process, cast doubt on the legitimacy of the result and eroded public trust, both domestically and internationally, in any new government;’
